Codex-specific runner exit issue (event: codex.manager.runner_exited) affecting Codex accounts. The regression tag and reference to #2150 indicate a known Codex problem has resurged. Belongs in Codex integration where runner lifecycle and account-specific behavior is owned. WARNING level suggests observable but non-blocking; 41 occurrences in 5 days shows steady recurrence requiring investigation and a fix to prevent runner churn.

pr_population.merged_fetch_failed originates in server/github/pr_population.py, the poller that populates PR/merge-queue/CI status data consumed by the pipeline view. The failure is caught, logged, and best-effort recovers on the next poll cycle (returns None for that repo's merged-PR block). Only 3 occurrences against one repo (cairnea/KinDash) since 2026-09-25.

Fixes a bug in the backlog runner's PR-Doctor handoff lifecycle (_backlog_handoff/_backlog_pr_status_for/_sweep_one): handed-off runner rows never resolved their PR via implementation_session_id, so the finished handoff operation kept holding the batch's issue keys forever (273 rows/218 held ops in prod). This is core Autopilot & Backlog Runner machinery (governed backlog progression and yielding on completion), not PR Doctor's own conflict-resolution feature — no candidate feature exists for PR Doctor specifically, and this is squarely the runner's handoff/sweep bookkeeping.
